$comment: The music bed of every Spatial Adjust video, decided at gate G5 (video/approvals.md; the options are in video/brand/music-shortlist.md). track.file is relative to the media root and is never in git; track.sha256 is the identity of that file, and video/edit/mix.py refuses any other (and always refuses the iCentral preview track). video/edit/build.py re-cuts the bed on the bar grid in track.sections: the intro, whole bars of the loop, then the outro, with track.sections.final (the last chord) landed on the end card. A final needs approval G5 decided and a licence reference. The sections are checked against the measured beat grid by python3 video/edit/audio/loop_points.py.
